title: Leslie G Probable NDE 9338
content: I was 17 years old, on a date with my then boyfriend and our friend. After seeing a movie, we were required to cross a four lane highway to get back to our parked car. We were standing in the turning lane, as I bent down to fix my shoe lace, a Jeep Wagoneer, crossed two lanes of travel and struck me in the turning lane. I was thrown into the air, and landed on the pavement on my face. I did wake up and remember thinking, it’s so bright, but it was midnight, and it was so cold, but it was the middle of June. I was taken to the hospital, where it was found that I had multiple trauma and life-threatening injuries requiring immediate surgery. I remember waking up as the surgeon was beginning the surgery, I felt like I was being ripped apart. At some point, I had no discernible heart beat and my pupils were fixed and dilated. During this time, I found myself in a extremely dark, warm, peaceful place, for lack of a better word, I couldn’t see anything, but I wasn’t afraid. I felt a “presence” but I couldn’t see anything. I had no fear, although I was confused. I spent a month in the hospital. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 6/15/1984 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death I sustained multiple trauma How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I felt as if I would be okay despite the confusion I was feeling. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was in the dark void Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I couldn’t see, but I felt Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was deafeningly silent Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Peace, warmth, contentment Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated I was baptized Methodist, but my mother did believe in religion Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I’m more connected to the universe and my relationship with God. What is your religion now? Other or several faiths Spiritual Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I am more open to understanding and try to put love and compassion into the world. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife probably exists No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life For a time I “forgot” this experience, I was young, in turmoil, had no support system. When one day in my early 20’s I had a flashback of the experience and kind of chalked it up to something significant but I was still not open enough to understand. I became a hospice nurse and I had a spiritual awakening in my life and now I have a better understanding of what I experienced and why I may have gone through the experience. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes How do you explain a darkness, darker than any darkness you’ve seen in your life, to express the experience correctly? How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes In my position as a hospice nurse, I can sense when a person is dying by a sensation I get in my body. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I truly can’t find words to express how it felt or how it changed me. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes 35 yrs., and most people look at me and don’t believe. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I know it was real, because I had no prior life experience to say otherwise. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Many things have happened in my life since. If it hadn’t happened, I may not be able to assist others when facing their death. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? I don’t think so.

arrival.other_being_detail: Felt/sensed a "presence" but could not see anything.

environment.environment_other_detail: An extremely dark, warm, peaceful place/void; could not see anything; "deafeningly silent."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Pedestrian struck by a vehicle while crossing/standing in a turning lane on a four-lane highway; multiple trauma; emergency surgery.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: unaffiliated (baptized Methodist). Now: "Other or several faiths" / spiritual.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience described as being in an extremely dark, warm, peaceful void with a sensed presence; no OBE, tunnel, light, beings seen, life review, or boundary.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No canonical stages reported except a void/darkness phase during a period of no discernible heartbeat and fixed/dilated pupils.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported "deafeningly silent" darkness; later (as a hospice nurse) can sense when a person is dying by a bodily sensation; reported temporarily "forgot" the experience until a flashback in early 20s.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “During this time, I found myself in a extremely dark, warm, peaceful place... I couldn’t see anything, but I wasn’t afraid.”
